acceptance_basis: Fresh-file geometry/dependency/camera checks plus all ten successful renders and independent Luna inspection of cold images. User requires saved-artifact survival; bit-exact GPU pixels are reported separately and are not claimed.

observations: All ten cold-open primary images preserve visible room geometry, materials, lighting, camera composition, and native labels.
CP-P01 / REACTOR, HX-01, pump, service, withdrawal, reserve, route, hoist, and workshop labels remain present and visibly usable.
No visible geometry loss, material substitution, missing label, or lighting defect was found in the cold images.
The larger numerical deltas are localized to HX-01 conformed lettering; the lettering remains visible in every affected view.
The neutral gray beyond-portal boundary remains intentionally unassembled and receives no neighbor-assembly credit.
limitations: The exact decoded RGB comparison remains REVIEW: all ten image pairs have decoded_pixels_equal=false.
Changed channels range from 211 to 2113, with maximum channel differences of 1 in five views and 7 to 9 in five HX-label views.
Mean absolute difference is at most 0.00062693/255 and RMS difference at most 0.03143/255; these measurements support stability but do not establish pixel equality.
Cold-open evidence covers saved-artifact survival and render repeatability only, not whole-map assembly or runtime-engine acceptance.
The live dependency audit's Blender built-in Bfont Regular <builtin> filesystem sentinel limitation remains documented; native text visibly survives cold renders.

Not bit-identical. Differences over one 8-bit channel step localize to conformed HX shell lettering; numerical surface sensitivity is an inference, not a proven renderer diagnosis. Historical exact-pixel REVIEW is retained unchanged. No runtime or whole-map claim.
